import json, subprocess
OK = {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
def run(doc, raw=None):
    data = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(doc).encode()
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','-B','main.py'], input=data, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace/project')
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode().strip(), p.stderr.decode()[:300]
FAILS = []
def case(name, doc, raw=None, want_error=True):
    code, out, err = run(doc, raw)
    ok = (code == 0) and (out == '{"error":"input"}' if want_error else out != '{"error":"input"}')
    if not ok:
        FAILS.append(name); print('FAIL', name, '->', out[:120], err[:200])
    return ok
def t(name, mutate, raw=None, want_error=True):
    doc = json.loads(json.dumps(OK)); mutate(doc); case(name, doc, raw, want_error)
def wc(mutate):
    def f(doc):
        doc['cases'] = [{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":{"method":"G","target":"/","host":"h"}}]
        mutate(doc)
    return f
def fr(frame):
    def f(doc):
        doc['cases'] = [{"name":"a","frames":[frame],"expect":{"method":"G","target":"/","host":"h"}}]
    return f
def ev(event):
    def f(doc):
        doc['events'] = [event]
    return f
def chn(channel):
    def f(doc):
        doc['channels'] = [channel]
    return f
